name: EMP Nerf for Yuri T3 Lasher Tanks (LTNK)
description: Half of the Yuri Lasher Light Tanks (LTNK) are held in an EMP-paralyzed (engine disabled) state until the human player builds a War Factory (GAWEAP/NAWEAP/YAWEAP). After that every tank returns to full strength. Per-unit runtime decision, so the AI is handled by the same rule set.
rules: rulesmd.ini [LTNK] (Owner=YuriCountry, Prerequisite=YAWEAP); War Factories: [GAWEAP] Allied, [NAWEAP] Soviet, [YAWEAP] Yuri
keys: N - toggle the EMP hold by hand (debug)
